## Objective
- Build a playable human-body simulation game for exploring anatomy, selecting condition profiles, mixing abstract components, and observing modeled physiological responses.
- Keep the simulation educational, with more anatomical detail, a broader component library, and richer visuals.

## Requirements
- Show muscles, veins, organs, and blood cells in an interactive anatomy view.
- Include selectable condition profiles, adjustable sandbox parameters, and mixable components.
- Clearly frame responses as educational, not medical advice or real dosing guidance.

## Decisions
- Use qualitative educational response modeling with abstract components and units, not real formulations or clinical recommendations.
- Approximate anatomy with Canvas rather than a true 3D model.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the app UI and Canvas anatomy visualization in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `app.js`.

- `index.html`: App UI and interactive controls.
- `app.js`: Canvas anatomy drawing, condition profiles, vital readouts, component mixing, and response model.
- `styles.css`: Layout, visual styling, and responsive rules.
